#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

// IntegerUtils: static longCompare
namespace IntegerUtils {
    int longCompare(ll a, ll b) {
        if (a < b) return -1;
        if (a > b) return 1;
        return 0;
    }
}

// Pair<U,V>
template<typename U, typename V>
struct Pair {
    U first;
    V second;
    Pair(U first, V second) : first(first), second(second) {}
    bool operator==(const Pair& o) const {
        return first == o.first && second == o.second;
    }
    bool operator<(const Pair& o) const {
        if (first < o.first) return true;
        if (o.first < first) return false;
        return second < o.second;
    }
};

// IntComparator: comparable function object
struct IntComparator {
    int (*cmp)(int, int);
    IntComparator(int (*c)(int,int)) : cmp(c) {}
    int compare(int a, int b) const { return cmp(a,b); }
    static int defaultCmp(int a, int b) {
        if (a < b) return -1;
        if (a > b) return 1;
        return 0;
    }
    static IntComparator DEFAULT;
};
IntComparator IntComparator::DEFAULT = IntComparator(IntComparator::defaultCmp);

// Heap - binary heap with index tracking
class Heap {
private:
    IntComparator comparator;
    int size;
    vector<int> elements;
    vector<int> at;
public:
    Heap(int maxElement) : Heap(10, IntComparator::DEFAULT, maxElement) {}
    Heap(const IntComparator& comp, int maxElement) : Heap(10, comp, maxElement) {}
    Heap(int capacity, const IntComparator& comp, int maxElement)
        : comparator(comp), size(0), elements(capacity), at(maxElement, -1) {}
    bool isEmpty() const { return size == 0; }
    void add(int element) {
        ensureCapacity(size + 1);
        elements[size] = element;
        at[element] = size;
        shiftUp(size++);
    }
    void shiftUp(int index) {
        int value = elements[index];
        while (index != 0) {
            int parent = (index - 1) >> 1;
            int parentValue = elements[parent];
            if (comparator.compare(parentValue, value) <= 0) {
                elements[index] = value;
                at[value] = index;
                return;
            }
            elements[index] = parentValue;
            at[parentValue] = index;
            index = parent;
        }
        elements[0] = value;
        at[value] = 0;
    }
    void shiftDown(int index) {
        if (index < 0 || index >= size) throw logic_error("shiftDown out of bounds");
        while (true) {
            int child = (index << 1) + 1;
            if (child >= size) return;
            if (child + 1 < size && comparator.compare(elements[child], elements[child+1]) > 0)
                child++;
            if (comparator.compare(elements[index], elements[child]) <= 0) return;
            swap(index, child);
            index = child;
        }
    }
    int getIndex(int element) const { return at[element]; }
    int poll() {
        if (isEmpty()) throw out_of_range("Heap is empty");
        int result = elements[0];
        at[result] = -1;
        if (size == 1) {
            size = 0;
            return result;
        }
        elements[0] = elements[--size];
        at[elements[0]] = 0;
        shiftDown(0);
        return result;
    }
private:
    void swap(int first, int second) {
        int temp = elements[first];
        elements[first] = elements[second];
        elements[second] = temp;
        at[elements[first]] = first;
        at[elements[second]] = second;
    }
    void ensureCapacity(int capacity) {
        if ((int)elements.size() < capacity) {
            int newSize = max(2 * (int)elements.size(), capacity);
            elements.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
};

// Edge interface not needed, Graph uses arrays
struct Edge {
    int id;
    Edge(int id) : id(id) {}
};

class Graph {
public:
    static const int REMOVED_BIT = 0;
    int vertexCount;
    int edgeCount;
    vector<int> firstOutbound;
    vector<int> firstInbound;
    vector<Edge*> edges;
    vector<int> nextInbound;
    vector<int> nextOutbound;
    vector<int> from;
    vector<int> to;
    vector<ll> weight;
    vector<ll> capacity;
    vector<int> reverseEdge;
    vector<int> flags;

    Graph(int vertexCount) : Graph(vertexCount, vertexCount) {}
    Graph(int vertexCount, int edgeCapacity)
        : vertexCount(vertexCount), edgeCount(0),
          firstOutbound(vertexCount, -1),
          firstInbound(vertexCount, -1),
          edges(),
          nextInbound(),
          nextOutbound(edgeCapacity),
          from(edgeCapacity), to(edgeCapacity),
          weight(), capacity(),
          reverseEdge(), flags(edgeCapacity) {}

    int addEdge(int fromID, int toID, ll weightVal, ll capacityVal, int revEdge) {
        ensureEdgeCapacity(edgeCount + 1);
        if (firstOutbound[fromID] != -1)
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = firstOutbound[fromID];
        else
            nextOutbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        firstOutbound[fromID] = edgeCount;
        if (firstInbound[toID] != -1)
            nextInbound[edgeCount] = firstInbound[toID];
        else
            nextInbound[edgeCount] = -1;
        firstInbound[toID] = edgeCount;
        this->from[edgeCount] = fromID;
        this->to[edgeCount] = toID;
        if (capacityVal != 0) {
            if (this->capacity.empty()) this->capacity.assign(from.size(), 0);
            this->capacity[edgeCount] = capacityVal;
        }
        if (weightVal != 0) {
            if (this->weight.empty()) this->weight.assign(from.size(), 0);
            this->weight[edgeCount] = weightVal;
        }
        if (revEdge != -1) {
            if (this->reverseEdge.empty()) {
                this->reverseEdge.assign(from.size(), -1);
            }
            this->reverseEdge[edgeCount] = revEdge;
        }
        if (!edges.empty()) {
            edges[edgeCount] = new Edge(edgeCount);
        }
        return edgeCount++;
    }

    int addFlowWeightedEdge(int from, int to, ll weight, ll capacity) {
        if (capacity == 0) {
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, 0, -1);
        } else {
            int lastEdgeCount = edgeCount;
            addEdge(to, from, -weight, 0, lastEdgeCount + entriesPerEdge());
            return addEdge(from, to, weight, capacity, lastEdgeCount);
        }
    }

    int entriesPerEdge() const { return 1; }

    int firstOutbound(int vertex) {
        int id = firstOutbound[vertex];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int nextOutbound(int id) {
        id = nextOutbound[id];
        while (id != -1 && isRemoved(id)) {
            id = nextOutbound[id];
        }
        return id;
    }

    int source(int id) const { return from[id]; }
    int destination(int id) const { return to[id]; }
    ll weight(int id) const { return weight.empty() ? 0 : weight[id]; }
    ll capacity(int id) const { return capacity.empty() ? 0 : capacity[id]; }
    ll flow(int id) const { return reverseEdge.empty() ? 0 : capacity[reverseEdge[id]]; }

    void pushFlow(int id, ll flowVal) {
        if (flowVal == 0) return;
        if (flowVal > 0) {
            if (capacity(id) < flowVal) throw logic_error("Not enough capacity");
        } else {
            if (flow(id) < -flowVal) throw logic_error("Not enough capacity");
        }
        capacity[id] -= flowVal;
        capacity[reverseEdge[id]] += flowVal;
    }

    bool flag(int id, int bit) const { return (flags[id] >> bit) & 1; }
    bool isRemoved(int id) const { return flag(id, REMOVED_BIT); }

    bool isSparse() const {
        return vertexCount == 0 || edgeCount * 20 / vertexCount <= vertexCount;
    }

private:
    void ensureEdgeCapacity(int size) {
        if ((int)from.size() < size) {
            int newSize = max(size, 2 * (int)from.size());
            edges.resize(newSize, nullptr);
            from.resize(newSize);
            to.resize(newSize);
            nextOutbound.resize(newSize);
            nextInbound.resize(newSize);
            if (!weight.empty()) weight.resize(newSize);
            if (!capacity.empty()) capacity.resize(newSize);
            if (!reverseEdge.empty()) reverseEdge.resize(newSize);
            flags.resize(newSize);
        }
    }
};

// MinCostFlow
class MinCostFlow {
private:
    Graph& graph;
    int source;
    int destination;
    vector<ll> phi;
    vector<ll> dijkstraResult;
    vector<int> lastEdge;
    Heap* heap;
    int vertexCount;
    vector<int> visited;
    int visitIndex;

public:
    MinCostFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int destination, bool hasNegativeEdges)
        : graph(graph), source(source), destination(destination),
          phi(graph.vertexCount(), 0),
          dijkstraResult(graph.vertexCount()),
          lastEdge(graph.vertexCount()),
          heap(nullptr),
          vertexCount(graph.vertexCount()),
          visited(graph.vertexCount(), 0),
          visitIndex(0)
    {
        if (hasNegativeEdges) {
            fordBellman();
        }
        if (graph.isSparse()) {
            heap = new Heap(vertexCount, IntComparator([](int a, int b) {
                return IntegerUtils::longCompare(dijkstraResult[a], dijkstraResult[b]);
            }), vertexCount);
        }
    }

    ~MinCostFlow() { delete heap; }

    static Pair<ll,ll> minCostMaxFlow(Graph& graph, int source, int destination,
                                      bool hasNegativeEdges, ll maxFlow) {
        MinCostFlow mcmf(graph, source, destination, hasNegativeEdges);
        return mcmf.minCostMaxFlow(maxFlow);
    }

    Pair<ll,ll> minCostMaxFlow(ll maxFlow) {
        ll cost = 0;
        ll flow = 0;
        while (maxFlow != 0) {
            if (graph.isSparse()) {
                dijkstraAlgorithm();
            } else {
                dijkstraAlgorithmFull();
            }
            if (lastEdge[destination] == -1) {
                return Pair<ll,ll>(cost, flow);
            }
            for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
                if (dijkstraResult[i] != LLONG_MAX) {
                    phi[i] += dijkstraResult[i];
                }
            }
            int vertex = destination;
            ll currentFlow = maxFlow;
            ll currentCost = 0;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                currentFlow = min(currentFlow, graph.capacity(edgeID));
                currentCost += graph.weight(edgeID);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
            maxFlow -= currentFlow;
            cost += currentCost * currentFlow;
            flow += currentFlow;
            vertex = destination;
            while (vertex != source) {
                int edgeID = lastEdge[vertex];
                graph.pushFlow(edgeID, currentFlow);
                vertex = graph.source(edgeID);
            }
        }
        return Pair<ll,ll>(cost, flow);
    }

private:
    void fordBellman() {
        fill(phi.begin(), phi.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        phi[source] = 0;
        vector<bool> inQueue(vertexCount, false);
        vector<int> queue(vertexCount + 1);
        queue[0] = source;
        inQueue[source] = true;
        int stepCount = 0;
        int head = 0;
        int end = 1;
        int maxSteps = 2 * vertexCount * vertexCount;
        while (head != end) {
            int vertex = queue[head++];
            if (head == (int)queue.size()) head = 0;
            inQueue[vertex] = false;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(vertex);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                ll total = phi[vertex] + graph.weight(edgeID);
                int dest = graph.destination(edgeID);
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0 && phi[dest] > total) {
                    phi[dest] = total;
                    if (!inQueue[dest]) {
                        queue[end++] = dest;
                        if (end == (int)queue.size()) end = 0;
                        inQueue[dest] = true;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
            if (++stepCount > maxSteps) {
                throw logic_error("Graph contains negative cycle");
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithm() {
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        fill(lastEdge.begin(), lastEdge.end(), -1);
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        heap->add(source);
        while (!heap->isEmpty()) {
            int current = heap->poll();
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(current);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[current] + dijkstraResult[current];
                    if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                        dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                        if (heap->getIndex(next) == -1) {
                            heap->add(next);
                        } else {
                            heap->shiftUp(heap->getIndex(next));
                        }
                        lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }

    void dijkstraAlgorithmFull() {
        visitIndex++;
        fill(dijkstraResult.begin(), dijkstraResult.end(), LLONG_MAX);
        lastEdge[destination] = -1;
        dijkstraResult[source] = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < vertexCount; i++) {
            int index = -1;
            ll length = LLONG_MAX;
            for (int j = 0; j < vertexCount; j++) {
                if (visited[j] != visitIndex && dijkstraResult[j] < length) {
                    length = dijkstraResult[j];
                    index = j;
                }
            }
            if (index == -1) return;
            visited[index] = visitIndex;
            int edgeID = graph.firstOutbound(index);
            while (edgeID != -1) {
                if (graph.capacity(edgeID) != 0) {
                    int next = graph.destination(edgeID);
                    if (visited[next] != visitIndex) {
                        ll total = graph.weight(edgeID) - phi[next] + phi[index] + length;
                        if (dijkstraResult[next] > total) {
                            dijkstraResult[next] = total;
                            lastEdge[next] = edgeID;
                        }
                    }
                }
                edgeID = graph.nextOutbound(edgeID);
            }
        }
    }
};

// InputReader
class InputReader {
private:
    FILE* stream;
    vector<char> buf;
    int curChar;
    int numChars;
public:
    InputReader(FILE* stream) : stream(stream), buf(1024), curChar(0), numChars(0) {}
    int read() {
        if (numChars == -1) throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
        if (curChar >= numChars) {
            curChar = 0;
            numChars = fread(buf.data(), 1, buf.size(), stream);
            if (numChars <= 0) return -1;
        }
        return buf[curChar++];
    }
    int readInt() {
        int c = read();
        while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        int sgn = 1;
        if (c == '-') { sgn = -1; c = read(); }
        int res = 0;
        do {
            if (c < '0' || c > '9') throw runtime_error("InputMismatchException");
            res = res * 10 + (c - '0');
            c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res * sgn;
    }
    string readString() {
        int c = read();
        while (isspace(c)) c = read();
        string res;
        do {
            if (c != -1) res.push_back(c);
            c = read();
        } while (!isspace(c));
        return res;
    }
};

// TaskF
class TaskF {
public:
    int n;
    string s;
    vector<int> ugliness;

    void solve(int testNumber, InputReader& in, PrintWriter& out) {
        n = in.readInt();
        s = in.readString();
        ugliness.resize(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ugliness[i] = -in.readInt();
        }

        Graph graph(1 + 26 + n / 2 + 1);
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
            for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
                int cost = 0;
                if (c == s[i]) cost = min(cost, ugliness[i]);
                if (c == s[n - 1 - i]) cost = min(cost, ugliness[n - 1 - i]);
                graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + (c - 'a'), 1 + 26 + i, cost, 1);
            }
        }

        vector<int> occurs(128, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) occurs[s[i]]++;
        for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; ++c) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(0, 1 + (c - 'a'), 0, occurs[c]);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
            graph.addFlowWeightedEdge(1 + 26 + i, 1 + 26 + n / 2, 0, 2);
        }

        Pair<ll,ll> flow = MinCostFlow::minCostMaxFlow(graph, 0, 1 + 26 + n / 2, true, n);
        out << -flow.first << "\n";
    }
};

// Main
int main() {
    InputReader in(stdin);
    PrintWriter out(stdout);
    TaskF solver;
    solver.solve(1, in, out);
    out.close();
    return 0;
}
